description.value: The Victoria Regent Waterfront Hotel & Suites is an award-winning luxury property set directly on Victoria's Inner Harbour, offering a range of standard king rooms and condo-style one- and two-bedroom suites with full kitchens and private balconies. Its prime downtown location places touring cyclists within easy reach of Victoria's Inner Harbour pathways and the city's shops, museums, and restaurants. The hotel includes a free underground parking garage as a standard guest amenity.
